items.prompt: Point A is at (−3, 2) and point B is at (4, 2). How many units apart are A and B?
hints: The y-coordinates are the same, so the line is horizontal.
Count from −3 to 0, then from 0 to 4.
items.explanation: From −3 to 0 is 3 units and from 0 to 4 is 4 units. The distance is 3 + 4 = 7 units.

items.prompt: Three corners of a rectangle are at (−2, −1), (3, −1) and (3, 4). What are the coordinates of the fourth corner?
hints: Opposite sides of a rectangle are parallel to the axes here.
The fourth corner shares an x-coordinate with (−2, −1).
items.explanation: The corner above (−2, −1) and beside (3, 4) has the x-coordinate −2 and y-coordinate 4. It is at (−2, 4).

options.why: The fourth corner must be level with (3, 4), so its y-coordinate is 4.
The coordinates are swapped and do not match the rectangle.
This is not in line with the other corners.

items.prompt: The points P(−4, −3) and Q(6, 5) are the two ends of a straight line. What are the coordinates of the middle point of the line? Write them like (2, 3).
hints: The middle value of two numbers is their average.
